global_invariants: standalone extension; no Hermes core modification
all production behavior follows observed RED evidence
all implementation occurs in isolated worktrees
builder and reviewers use different profile/session identities
spec review passes before quality review
review and verification bind to exact immutable candidate SHA
completion requires fresh deterministic and required live behavior evidence
draft PR only; default branch is never auto-merged
telemetry excludes prompts, transcripts, secrets, raw tool arguments and raw user data

packages.name: foundation
required_behavior: versioned schemas for run, stage, review and evidence
documented state transitions and rejection reasons
third-party attribution for adapted Superpowers methodology

packages.name: control-plane
required_behavior: create or select one Kanban board per repository
materialize the complete stage dependency graph with self-contained briefs
persist revisioned run mappings and bounded evidence
enforce exact-SHA, task/profile identity, scope, observed RED, ordered reviews, deterministic verification and live acceptance
support attempt-bound repair loops without rewriting reviewed history
provide CLI create-run/show/approve-design/approve-plan/check/commit/review/verify/complete/repair commands

packages.name: superpowers-disciplines
required_behavior: automatic coding-intent bootstrap before source mutation
design interview and explicit approval
context-free granular implementation plans
strict TDD and YAGNI/DRY policies
fresh-task worker dispatch
spec review then quality review
systematic debugging and evidence-based review reception
verification-before-completion and provenance-aware branch finishing

packages.name: hermes-plugin-api
required_behavior: native plugin discovery and enable lifecycle
scoped read-only dashboard API for boards, runs, stages, evidence and reviews
bounded DTOs and strict identifier/path validation
no arbitrary filesystem or command surface

packages.name: desktop-ui
required_behavior: Coding Runs route, sidebar entry and command palette action
repository/board selector and run list
stage graph/status, profile/model, attempts, SHAs and blockers
safe evidence and review detail views
loading, empty, error and stale-candidate states
theme-safe and keyboard/accessibility behavior

packages.name: installation-and-live-proof
required_behavior: fixed-allowlist transactional install, uninstall and doctor scripts
safe Hermes-tool-dispatch source/orchestrator installation without clobbering unrelated config
unsafe direct-tool providers rejected before mutation; unsafe base receives dashboard-only projection
clean-session mutation is blocked until a workflow run is created
disposable repository completes full design-plan-contract-build-review-verify-live-handoff flow
Desktop shows the same durable run and evidence
restart/resume preserves run state

required_final_evidence: all focused and full tests passing
complete disposable-repository workflow transcript and artifacts
fresh independent review of final immutable head
draft PR or local handoff with manual merge gate preserved
